definition_zh: adj. 凸面的，凸出的
definition_en: curving outward like the outside of a ball
core_image: 一枚扣在地图上的放大镜鼓起来的镜面
scene: 凸透镜把阳光聚成一小团亮斑。A convex lens gathered the sunlight into a bright spot.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：convex 指凸面的；句意是凸透镜把阳光聚成亮斑。

senses.title: Curving outward
senses.definition: curving out like the outside of a sphere
senses.definitionCN: 像球的外表面那样向外鼓
senses.example: The mirror has a convex face.
senses.exampleCN: 这面镜子是凸面。
senses.why: A lid bowed upward.
senses.whyCN: 向上鼓起的一个盖子。

senses.title: Of a lens
senses.definition: thicker at the centre than the edge
senses.definitionCN: 中间厚、边缘薄
senses.example: A convex lens magnifies print.
senses.exampleCN: 凸透镜能放大字迹。
senses.why: Glasses that make letters bigger.
senses.whyCN: 把字放大的镜片。

senses.title: Of a polygon
senses.definition: with no inward dents
senses.definitionCN: 没有向内凹陷的
senses.example: A square is a convex polygon.
senses.exampleCN: 正方形是凸多边形。
senses.why: A rubber band touching every corner.
senses.whyCN: 贴住每个角的一根橡皮筋。

intro.en: Convex comes from Latin convexus, vaulted or arched.

items.en: Vehere means to carry.
items.cn: vehere 意为载运。

items.en: Convexus means arched or vaulted.
items.cn: convexus 意为拱起的。

items.en: English used convex of rounded forms.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语用它形容拱起的外形。

items.en: Optics named the bulging lens convex.
items.cn: 十八世纪光学把凸起的镜片称作 convex。

items.en: Geometry defined convex polygons.
items.cn: 现代几何定义了凸多边形。

normalIntro.cn: convex 像倒扣的碗外侧那样朝你鼓出来。

normal.en: Convexus means arched.

normal.en: Concave goes in, convex goes out.

normal.en: A convex lens is fat in the middle.
normal.cn: 凸透镜中间厚。

normal.en: A convex mirror shows a wide view.
normal.cn: 凸面镜能照出很宽的视野。

normal.en: A convex polygon has no dents.

abstract.en: The outside of an overturned bowl.
abstract.cn: 倒扣碗的外侧。

abstract.en: A bubble pushed up from a surface.
abstract.cn: 从表面鼓起的一个泡。

abstract.en: A camera watching a whole street.
abstract.cn: 能看整条街的镜头。

examples.en: The convex mirror shows the whole aisle.
examples.cn: 凸面镜映出整条过道。

examples.en: A convex lens makes small print readable.
examples.cn: 凸透镜让小字看得清。

branches.cn: 没有凹陷的图形。

branches.en: Curving out to gather light.
branches.cn: 向外鼓起以聚光。

branches.en: A rubber band on every corner.
branches.cn: 贴着每个角的橡皮筋。

latinIntro.en: Latin convexus means vaulted or arched.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 convexus 意为拱起的。

definition_zh: 传达；表达；运送
definition_en: to make an idea or feeling understood, or to carry something to a place
core_image: 一辆小车沿着窄路，把箱子从这头稳稳送到那头
scene: 她没说一句重话，只用一个眼神就让满屋的人明白了意思。Her silence conveyed more than any speech.
sceneCN: 这里 convey 指「传达」（第 1 个义项：把想法或信息传递给别人）；句意是她的沉默传达的意思胜过任何言语。

senses.title: To make understood
senses.definition: to make an idea or piece of information clear to other people
senses.definitionCN: 使想法或信息被别人清楚地理解
senses.example: Words cannot convey how grateful I am.
senses.exampleCN: 言语无法传达我有多么感激。
senses.why: A thought locked in one head is silent until something carries it out.
senses.whyCN: 锁在一个脑子里的想法是无声的，直到有东西把它运出去。

senses.title: To carry to a place
senses.definition: to take people or goods from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把人或货物从一处送到另一处
senses.example: The pipes convey water to the village.
senses.exampleCN: 这些管道把水送到村里。
senses.why: Before a word could mean to tell, it meant to carry.
senses.whyCN: 在表示告诉之前，这个词先表示搬运。

senses.title: To show a feeling
senses.definition: to let a feeling be seen or felt without stating it plainly
senses.definitionCN: 不必明说，就让某种情感被看见或被感到
senses.example: Her smile conveyed quiet confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她的微笑传达出安静的自信。
senses.why: A face can carry a message further than a sentence.
senses.whyCN: 一张脸能把消息送得比一句话更远。

intro.en: Convey comes from Old French conveier, to escort, from Latin conviare, built from com-, together, and via, a way.
intro.cn: convey 来自古法语 conveier（护送），源于拉丁语 conviare，由 com-（一起）与 via（道路）构成。

items.en: Via meant a road or a way through.
items.cn: via 意为道路或通行的路线。

items.en: Conviare meant to travel together along a road.
items.cn: conviare 意为沿路一同行走。

items.en: Old French conveier meant to escort a person on the way.
items.cn: 古法语 conveier 意为在路上护送某人。

items.en: English convey first meant to carry or transport goods.
items.cn: 英语 convey 最初指搬运或运输货物。

items.en: The sense widened to carrying ideas and feelings.
items.cn: 词义扩大，开始指传递想法与情感。

items.en: Today it is used as often for meaning as for goods.
items.cn: 今天它用于含义的频率不亚于用于货物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin way base via-, and the meaning group names other verbs of carrying or telling.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的道路词基 via-，近义组列出其他表示运送或表达的说法。

entries.definition: a group of vehicles travelling together
a machine that carries things along
entries.definitionCN: 沿线路运送东西的机器

entries.definition: a person sent to speak for a country
to make information known to others
to carry goods from one place to another
entries.definitionCN: 把货物从一处运到另一处

entries.definition: to show a thought or feeling in words
entries.definitionCN: 用言语表达想法或感情

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cart on a road, then move to a message crossing a room and to a feeling shown on a face.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从路上的一辆车开始，再到一条消息穿过房间，最后到脸上的表情。

normal.en: Con- is together and vey is a way, so convey is to travel a road with something and hand it over.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，vey 是路，convey 就是带着东西走一段路，再交到别人手里。

normal.en: A truck conveys boxes; a sentence conveys a thought.
normal.cn: 卡车运送箱子，句子运送想法。

normal.en: The word hides via, the Latin road, in its last three letters.
normal.cn: 这个词最后三个字母里藏着拉丁语的道路 via。

normal.en: If the listener understands, the delivery has arrived.
normal.cn: 只要听的人懂了，这趟运送就算送到了。

normal.en: A quiet look can convey what shouting cannot.
normal.cn: 一个安静的眼神，能传达喊叫传达不了的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow road with one cart moving steadily.
abstract.cn: 想象一条窄路上，一辆小车稳稳前行。

abstract.en: Picture a paper note passed hand to hand across a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条在房间里被一只手传到另一只手。

abstract.en: Picture a warm light carried from one window to the next.
abstract.cn: 想象一点暖光从一扇窗被带到下一扇窗。

examples.en: He struggled to convey his excitement in English.
examples.cn: 他努力用英语表达自己的兴奋。

examples.en: The river conveys silt to the plain each spring.
examples.cn: 每年春天，这条河把泥沙运到平原。

examples.en: A short note can convey a great deal of warmth.
examples.cn: 一张短笺能传达许多暖意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 convey 记成 con（一起）加 vey（路）：陪着东西走一段路，就是运送，也就是把意思送到别人心里。

root: 源自拉丁语 via（道路），经 conviare（同行）与古法语 conveier（护送）进入英语，本指沿路运送，后引申为传达与表达。

sensesIntro.en: From goods carried along a road, to a thought carried into another mind, and at last to a feeling shown without words.
sensesIntro.cn: 从沿路运送的货物，到送进另一个头脑的想法，最后到不用言语表达的情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small cart carrying a box along a narrow road.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆小车沿着窄路运送一只箱子。

branches.en: A message crosses the gap between two minds.
branches.cn: 一条消息跨越两个头脑之间的空隙。

branches.en: A pipe or a cart moves real goods to a place.
branches.cn: 管道或车辆把真实货物送到某地。

branches.en: A face or a gesture carries a feeling without words.
branches.cn: 一张脸或一个手势不用言语就带出了情感。

branches.en: Both senses move something inward, one clear and one quiet.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把某种东西送进人心，一个清楚，一个安静。

branches.en: The physical trip came first, and the mental trip borrowed its shape.
branches.cn: 具体的运送先出现，心灵的传递借用了它的形状。

intro.en: Convey is built on Latin com-, together, plus via, a road, through the Old French verb conveier.
intro.cn: convey 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 via（道路）构成，经古法语动词 conveier 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The road base via- also shows in deviate, obvious and envoy.
latinIntro.cn: 道路词基 via- 也出现在 deviate、obvious 与 envoy 中。

items.exampleCN: 公交车是公共交通工具。

items.meaning: a person sent on a way

items.meaning: right in the way, plain to see

definition_zh: 判定…有罪；罪犯；囚犯
definition_en: to decide in a court that someone is guilty, or a person kept in prison for a crime
core_image: 法槌落下，一句判决把被告从席位上推向牢门
scene: 证据摆满桌面，陪审团低声商议后给出了结论。The jury voted to convict him of theft.
sceneCN: 这里 convict 指「判定有罪」（第 1 个义项：法庭认定某人有罪）；句意是陪审团投票认定他犯有盗窃罪。

senses.title: To find guilty
senses.definition: to decide officially in a court that someone has committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 由法庭正式认定某人犯有某项罪行
senses.example: The court convicted him of fraud.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭判定他犯有诈骗罪。
senses.why: A court does not say maybe; it says guilty, and the door closes.
senses.whyCN: 法庭不说也许，只说有罪，然后门就关上了。

senses.title: A person in prison
senses.definition: someone who has been found guilty and is serving a sentence
senses.definitionCN: 已被判定有罪并在服刑的人
senses.example: The convict worked in the prison kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 这名囚犯在监狱厨房里干活。
senses.why: A verdict spoken once becomes a name worn for years.
senses.whyCN: 一次宣判说出口，就变成一个要穿很多年的名字。

intro.en: Convict comes from Latin convictus, the past participle of convincere, to prove wrong, built from com-, together, and vincere, to conquer.
intro.cn: convict 来自拉丁语 convictus，是 convincere（证明有错）的过去分词，由 com-（一起）与 vincere（征服）构成。

items.en: Vincere meant to conquer or overcome an opponent.
items.cn: vincere 意为征服或战胜对手。

items.en: Convincere meant to overcome someone with proof.
items.cn: convincere 意为用证据把对方驳倒。

items.en: Convictus described a person overcome by the evidence.
items.cn: convictus 形容被证据压倒的人。

items.en: English convict first meant to prove a person guilty.
items.cn: 英语 convict 最初指证明某人有罪。

items.en: The noun convict named a prisoner sent to a penal colony.
items.cn: 名词 convict 指被送往流放地的囚犯。

items.en: The verb now belongs to courtrooms and the noun to prisons.
items.cn: 今天动词属于法庭，名词属于监狱。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin conquering base vict-, and the meaning group names other words for blame and for prisoners.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的征服词基 vict-，近义组列出其他表示判罪与囚犯的词。

entries.definition: a court decision that someone is guilty
to make someone believe something
to force someone out of a place
to say officially that someone is guilty
a person kept in prison
a person who has broken the law

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with proof that beats a denial, then move to the verdict and to the man it names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从压倒辩解的证据开始，再到那声判决，最后到判决所命名的人。

normal.en: Con- is together and vict is to conquer, so convict is to conquer someone with proof.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，vict 是征服，convict 就是用证据把人征服。

normal.en: The same letters name the act and the man: first you convict, then he is a convict.
normal.cn: 同一串字母既指动作也指人：先判定有罪，然后他就成了罪犯。

normal.en: Stress moves like the gavel: con-VICT the act, CON-vict the man.
normal.cn: 重音像法槌一样落下：动作读 con-VICT，指人读 CON-vict。

normal.en: Convict and convince share a base, but proof, not persuasion, puts a person in prison.
normal.cn: convict 与 convince 同根，但把人送进监狱的是证据，不是劝说。

normal.en: A verdict is a sentence that turns a listener into a prisoner.
normal.cn: 一句判决，就是一句把听者变成囚犯的话。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy stamp coming down on a sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚沉重的印章压在一张纸上。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom door closing slowly behind one person.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭的门在一个人身后慢慢关上。

abstract.en: Picture a chain of proof pulling tight around a claim.
abstract.cn: 想象一条证据链在一个说法周围收紧。

examples.en: The jury took three hours to convict her.
examples.cn: 陪审团用了三个小时才判定她有罪。

examples.en: He was convicted of stealing a car.
examples.cn: 他被判犯有偷车罪。

examples.en: The convict had spent ten years inside.
examples.cn: 那名囚犯已经在狱中待了十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 convict 记成 con（完全）加 vict（征服）：证据完全把人征服，就是判定有罪。

root: 源自拉丁语 convincere（用证据驳倒），由 com-（一起、完全）与 vincere（征服）构成，本指以证据压倒对方，后指法庭定罪。

sensesIntro.en: From proof that overcomes a denial, to the verdict it produces, and at last to the person that verdict names.
sensesIntro.cn: 从压过辩解的证据，到由此产生的判决，最后到判决所命名的那个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gavel falling and a prison door closing.
core.cn: 核心意象：法槌落下，牢门关上。

branches.en: Proof conquers doubt and the court says guilty.
branches.cn: 证据战胜怀疑，法庭宣布有罪。

branches.en: The verdict becomes a label worn by a living person.
branches.cn: 判决变成一个活人身上背着的标签。

branches.en: One word holds both the ruling and the ruled-against.
branches.cn: 一个词同时装着裁决和被裁决的人。

branches.en: The verb needs a court, a charge and a conclusion.
branches.cn: 这个动词需要法庭、指控与结论。

branches.en: The noun needs only a person and a closed door.
branches.cn: 这个名词只需要一个人和一扇关上的门。

intro.en: Convict is built on Latin com-, together or completely, plus vincere, to conquer.
intro.cn: convict 由拉丁语 com-（一起、完全）与 vincere（征服）构成。

latinIntro.en: The conquering base vict- or vinc- also runs through convince, victory and invincible.
latinIntro.cn: 征服词基 vict- 或 vinc- 也贯穿 convince、victory 与 invincible。

items.meaning: the state of being proven guilty
items.exampleCN: 这项定罪后来被撤销了。

items.meaning: to win someone over by argument
to turn a person out of a place
items.exampleCN: 他们在冬天被赶了出去。

items.example: The victory came at a cost.

items.exampleCN: 没有哪支队伍是不可战胜的。

definition_zh: 定罪；判罪；坚定信念
definition_en: a court decision that someone is guilty, or a strong and steady belief
core_image: 一纸判决放在桌上，胸口另有一只手始终不肯松开
scene: 宣判之后，她仍抬起头，说自己相信这条路是对的。She spoke with the conviction of someone who had waited years.
sceneCN: 这里 conviction 指「坚定信念」（第 2 个义项：深信不疑的看法）；句意是她说话时带着一种等了多年的坚定信念。

senses.title: A court ruling of guilt
senses.definition: an official decision that a person is guilty of a crime
senses.definitionCN: 正式认定某人犯有某项罪行的决定
senses.example: The conviction was overturned on appeal.
senses.exampleCN: 这项定罪在上诉时被推翻了。
senses.why: A single ruling can follow a person for the rest of a life.
senses.whyCN: 一次裁决可能跟着一个人走过余生。

senses.title: A steady belief
senses.definition: a firm belief that something is true or right
senses.definitionCN: 坚信某事为真或为对的看法
senses.example: She lives by the conviction that work should be fair.
senses.exampleCN: 她秉持工作应当公平的信念生活。
senses.why: A belief that survives argument is held by something stronger than habit.
senses.whyCN: 经得住争辩的信念，靠的比习惯更结实。

intro.en: Conviction comes from Latin convictio, a proving of guilt, from convincere, to overcome with proof, built from com-, together, and vincere, to conquer.
intro.cn: conviction 来自拉丁语 convictio（证明有罪），源于 convincere（用证据驳倒），由 com-（一起）与 vincere（征服）构成。

items.en: Vincere meant to conquer and to carry the day.
items.cn: vincere 意为征服、占上风。

items.en: Convincere meant to overcome a person by clear proof.
items.cn: convincere 意为用清楚的证据把人驳倒。

items.en: Convictio named both the proof and the state of being proven wrong.
items.cn: convictio 既指证据，也指被证明有错的状态。

items.en: English conviction first meant the proving of guilt.
items.cn: 英语 conviction 最初指对罪行的证明。

items.en: The same word came to mean a belief held beyond doubt.
items.cn: 同一个词开始表示不容怀疑的信念。

items.en: Law keeps the first sense, while daily speech keeps the second.
items.cn: 法律保留了第一个义项，日常口语保留了第二个。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin conquering base vict-, and the meaning group names other words for belief and for legal decisions.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的征服词基 vict-，近义组列出其他表示信念与法律裁决的词。

entries.definition: to find someone guilty in court
entries.definitionCN: 在法庭上判定某人有罪

entries.definition: to make someone feel sure
the act of forcing someone out of a place
a feeling that something is true
a state of being completely sure
the punishment given by a court

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a verdict written down, then move to a belief that cannot be argued away.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一纸写下的判决开始，再到一个争辩不掉的信念。

normal.en: Convict is the act and conviction is the result, so a conviction is what is left after proof has won.
normal.cn: convict 是动作，conviction 是结果：证据赢了之后留下的东西就是定罪。

normal.en: The same word serves the courtroom and the heart.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既服务法庭，也服务人心。

normal.en: Say it with conviction and people lean in; say it without and they look away.
normal.cn: 带着信念说，人会靠近；不带信念说，人会转开目光。

normal.en: -ion turns the verb into a thing you can carry.

normal.cn: 一个短短的单词，同时管温度、脾气和品味。

normal.en: Cool weather cools a drink, and a cool head cools a quarrel.
normal.cn: 凉爽的天气让饮料变凉，冷静的头脑让争吵降温。

normal.en: Compare cool with cold: cool is the pleasant side of cold.
normal.cn: 把 cool 和 cold 比一比：cool 是冷里让人舒服的那一面。

normal.en: To play it cool is to keep the face calm while the heart races.
normal.cn: play it cool 就是心里乱跳，脸上却平静。

normal.en: The adjective and the verb share one shape, so the wind cools the room.
normal.cn: 形容词与动词同形，于是风把房间吹凉。

abstract.en: Picture a glass sweating on a table in July.
abstract.cn: 想象七月里桌上一只冒水珠的杯子。

abstract.en: Picture a lake surface with no ripple at dawn.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明时没有一丝波纹的湖面。

abstract.en: Picture someone leaning back while others lean in.
abstract.cn: 想象别人都向前倾时，有个人向后靠着。

examples.en: The evening air turned cool after the rain.
examples.cn: 雨后傍晚的空气变凉了。

examples.en: He kept cool and answered every question slowly.
examples.cn: 他保持冷静，慢慢回答了每个问题。

examples.en: Let the soup cool before you taste it.
examples.cn: 让汤凉一点再尝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cool 记成一口凉气：温度退一步是凉爽，情绪退一步是冷静，风格退一步就成了酷。

root: 源自日耳曼语中意为冷的词根，古英语作 col，本指适度寒冷，后引申为冷静自制，二十世纪又引申为时髦。

sensesIntro.en: From air that is pleasantly cold, to a temper held steady, and at last to a style others admire.
sensesIntro.cn: 从宜人微凉的空气，到稳稳管住的脾气，最后到别人欣赏的风格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cool breeze moving through a warm room.
core.cn: 核心意象：一阵凉风穿过温热的房间。

branches.en: A lower temperature brings comfort.
branches.cn: 更低的温度带来舒适。

branches.en: A steady mind keeps its balance in noise.
branches.cn: 沉稳的心在喧闹里保持平衡。

branches.en: Admired style borrows the word for pleasant distance.
branches.cn: 被人欣赏的风格，借用了这种舒服的距离感。

branches.en: Both rest on a step back from heat.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在从热里退后一步。

branches.en: Calm and cool style both look unbothered.
branches.cn: 冷静与酷的风格，看起来都不慌不忙。

intro.en: Cool is a native Germanic word, and its family grows with -er, -ly, -ness and -ing.
intro.cn: cool 是本族日耳曼词，它的家族由 -er、-ly、-ness 与 -ing 扩展而来。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base for cold, frig-, appears in fridge, frigid and refrigerant.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示冷的词基 frig- 出现在 fridge、frigid 与 refrigerant 中。

items.meaning: a container that keeps things cold
items.meaningCN: 让东西保持低温的容器
items.example: Put the milk in the cooler.

items.meaning: the act of making less warm
a fluid that carries heat away

items.exampleCN: 这首歌如今听起来不酷了。

definition_zh: 合作；配合；协助
definition_en: to work together with others for a shared aim, or to do what is asked of you
core_image: 两双手同时抬起同一只箱子，脚步踩在一个节拍上
scene: 谁也不肯先动，老师只好请两个小组一起想办法。The two teams agreed to cooperate on the project.
sceneCN: 这里 cooperate 指「合作」（第 1 个义项：为共同目标一起做事）；句意是两个小组同意在这个项目上合作。

senses.title: To work together
senses.definition: to join with others in doing something for a shared aim
senses.definitionCN: 与他人一起为共同目标做某事
senses.example: The two schools cooperate on a summer camp.
senses.exampleCN: 两所学校在夏令营上合作。
senses.why: One pair of hands can lift only so much; four hands lift the rest.
senses.whyCN: 一双手能抬起的有限，另外两双手抬起剩下的。

senses.title: To go along with a request
senses.definition: to do what someone in authority asks, without resisting
senses.definitionCN: 按当权者的要求去做，不加抗拒
senses.example: Please cooperate with the officer at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 请配合门口的工作人员。
senses.why: Sometimes working together means simply not pushing back.
senses.whyCN: 有时合作就是干脆不往回推。

intro.en: Cooperate comes from Late Latin cooperari, built from co-, together, and operari, to work, from opus, work.
intro.cn: cooperate 来自晚期拉丁语 cooperari，由 co-（一起）与 operari（工作）构成，词根 opus 意为工作。

items.en: Opus meant work, a task or a piece of labour.
items.cn: opus 意为工作、任务或一份劳动。

items.en: Operari meant to work or to be busy with a task.
items.cn: operari 意为工作或忙于某项任务。

items.en: Cooperari meant to work along with another person.
items.cn: cooperari 意为与另一个人一起工作。

items.en: English cooperate first described working jointly on a task.
items.cn: 英语 cooperate 最初指共同做一项工作。

items.en: The word gained the milder sense of agreeing to help.
items.cn: 这个词又获得了同意协助这一较温和的含义。

items.en: Today it covers teams, machines and even countries.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖团队、机器，甚至国家。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin working base oper-, and the meaning group names other ways of acting with others.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的工作词基 oper-，近义组列出其他与他人共同行动的说法。

entries.definition: to work or to make a machine work
the act of working together
willing to work with others
to work closely with someone on a project
entries.definitionCN: 与某人在项目上紧密合作

entries.definition: to help someone with a task
entries.definitionCN: 在某项任务上帮助某人

entries.definition: to join together for a common end

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two pairs of hands on one box, then move to a person agreeing to help.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两双手抬起同一只箱子开始，再到一个人同意协助。

normal.en: Co- means together and operate means to work, so cooperate is to work together.
normal.cn: co- 是一起，operate 是工作，cooperate 就是一起工作。

normal.en: Two people carry a table more easily than one, and the word is built for that picture.
normal.cn: 两个人抬桌子比一个人轻松，这个词就是为这幅画面造的。

normal.en: Say it as co-operate and the meaning appears by itself.
normal.cn: 把它读作 co-operate，意思自己就出来了。

normal.en: A cooperative person makes the room lighter.
normal.cn: 一个愿意配合的人，会让整个房间轻松起来。

normal.en: Even machines cooperate: two gears turn each other.
normal.cn: 连机器也会合作：两个齿轮彼此带动。

abstract.en: Picture two hands lifting the same heavy box.
abstract.cn: 想象两双手抬起同一只重箱子。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers meeting and sharing one bed.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河汇合，共用一条河床。

abstract.en: Picture a door opened from both sides at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门同时从两边被推开。

examples.en: We must cooperate if the plan is to work.
examples.cn: 若要让计划奏效，我们必须合作。

examples.en: She cooperated with the police without hesitation.
examples.cn: 她毫不犹豫地配合了警方。

examples.en: The two labs cooperate closely on this research.
examples.cn: 这两个实验室在这项研究上密切合作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cooperate 记成 co（一起）加 operate（工作）：一起干活，就是合作。

root: 源自晚期拉丁语 cooperari（一同工作），由 co-（一起）与 operari（工作）构成，词根 opus 意为工作。

sensesIntro.en: From hands lifting one load together, to a person choosing not to resist.
sensesIntro.cn: 从几双手一同抬起一份重物，到一个人选择不加抗拒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pairs of hands raising one box.
core.cn: 核心意象：两双手抬起同一只箱子。

branches.en: People pool effort toward one shared aim.
branches.cn: 人们把力气汇向同一个目标。

branches.en: A person simply lets the request be carried out.
branches.cn: 一个人干脆让那个要求被顺利执行。

branches.en: Both senses lower the friction between people.
branches.cn: 两个义项都减少了人与人之间的摩擦。

branches.en: The first sense needs a common purpose.
branches.cn: 第一个义项需要一个共同的目的。

branches.en: The second needs only a willing response.
branches.cn: 第二个义项只需要一个愿意的回应。

intro.en: Cooperate is built on Latin co-, together, plus operari, to work.
intro.cn: cooperate 由拉丁语 co-（一起）与 operari（工作）构成。

latinIntro.en: The working base oper- also appears in operate, operation and opus.
latinIntro.cn: 工作词基 oper- 也出现在 operate、operation 与 opus 中。

items.meaningCN: 愿意与他人一起做事的

items.meaning: to work or run a machine
the act of working or running
a person who runs a machine

那部大提琴作品很有名。

definition_zh: 合作；为共同目标一起行动，也指愿意配合他人的态度
definition_en: the act of working together toward a shared goal, or the willingness to help when asked
core_image: 两个人各抬一端，把同一件重物搬到同一处
scene: 实验室里，两名研究人员一人扶住支架、一人拧紧螺丝，几分钟就把装置装好。One researcher steadies the frame while the other tightens the bolts, and the job is finished through cooperation.
sceneCN: 这里 cooperation 指「为共同目标一起行动」（第 1 个义项：各方分担同一任务的不同部分）；句意为一名研究者扶住支架、另一名拧紧螺丝，装置靠合作很快装好。图中可辨识物件：支架、螺丝、两只手、装配好的装置。

pos.zh: 合作；协作；配合（不可数；具体合作项目可用复数）

senses.title: Working together toward one goal
senses.definition: the act of working with others toward a shared aim
senses.definitionCN: 与他人一起为共同目标做事
senses.example: One researcher steadies the frame while the other tightens the bolts.
senses.exampleCN: 一名研究者扶住支架，另一名拧紧螺丝。
senses.why: co- 'together' plus operari 'to work' says exactly what the word does: two or more agents put their work into one result.
senses.whyCN: co-「一起」加 operari「做事」，正好说出这个词的动作：两个或更多行动者把自己的劳动放进同一个结果。

senses.title: Willingness to help when asked
senses.definition: the readiness to assist someone who asks for help or permission
senses.definitionCN: 愿意帮助提出请求或需要许可的人
senses.example: Thank you for your cooperation during the inspection.
senses.exampleCN: 感谢您在检查期间的配合。
senses.why: the same word names the attitude behind joint work; a request for cooperation asks for access and effort rather than a formal partnership.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指共同做事背后的态度；请求 cooperation 要的是配合与便利，而不是正式合伙关系。

senses.title: Mutual aid in nature
senses.definition: behavior in which organisms act together in ways that benefit both partners
senses.definitionCN: 生物共同行动、双方都获益的行为
senses.example: Ants and acacia trees cooperate: shelter for defence.
senses.exampleCN: 蚂蚁与金合欢合作：住所换防卫。
senses.why: biology borrowed the word because two species can also divide a job, and the shared benefit is measurable in survival and offspring.
senses.whyCN: 生物学借用了这个词，因为两个物种也能分担同一件事，而共同收益可以用存活与后代来衡量。

senses.title: Partnership between organizations
senses.definition: joint work between institutions, departments or agencies that keep their own identities
senses.definitionCN: 保持各自身份的机构、部门或机关之间的共同工作
senses.example: The museum works in cooperation with the local school.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆与当地学校合作。
senses.why: organizations cooperate rather than merge; each keeps its boundary but contributes a part, which is why the phrase in cooperation with is so common.
senses.whyCN: 机构是合作而不是合并；各方保留边界却各出一部分，因此「与……合作」这一说法极为常见。

senses.title: International and economic cooperation
senses.definition: coordinated action between countries or firms on trade, aid, research or security
senses.definitionCN: 国家或企业在贸易、援助、研究或安全上的协调行动
senses.example: The two countries signed a cooperation agreement on clean energy.
senses.exampleCN: 两国签署了一项清洁能源合作协议。
senses.why: the modern political sense scales the same division of labour up to states, where no one can compel the other and agreement must be negotiated.
senses.whyCN: 现代政治义把同一种分工放大到国家层面：任何一方都无法强迫对方，合作必须通过协商达成。

senses.title: Coordination of parts in a system
senses.definition: the way parts of a body, machine or system work together so that the whole functions
senses.definitionCN: 身体、机器或系统的各部分协同运作，使整体发挥功能
senses.example: Walking depends on the cooperation of muscles and joints.
senses.exampleCN: 行走依赖肌肉与关节的协同。
senses.why: once the word leaves people, it can describe any set of parts whose combined action produces an effect none could produce alone.
senses.whyCN: 一旦离开人，这个词就能描述任何一组部件：它们的联合动作产生单个部件无法产生的效果。

senses.title: Compliance with authority
senses.titleCN: 对执法或管理方的配合
senses.definition: the act of following instructions or allowing an official procedure to proceed
senses.definitionCN: 遵从指示或允许官方程序顺利进行
senses.example: The driver's cooperation helped the officers clear the road.
senses.exampleCN: 司机的配合帮助警员清理了道路。
senses.why: cooperation here is one-sided compliance; the word softens a demand by presenting it as shared work.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 cooperation 是单方面的顺从；这个词把一项要求说成共同工作，从而缓和了语气。

senses.title: A cooperative strategy in game theory
senses.definition: a strategy in which players choose actions that raise the joint outcome instead of competing for the larger share
senses.definitionCN: 参与者选择提高联合收益、而非争夺更大份额的策略
senses.example: In the repeated game, cooperation pays only if the other side also keeps its promise.
senses.exampleCN: 在重复博弈中，只有当对方也守约时，合作才划算。
senses.why: game theory makes the word technical: cooperation is not goodwill but a strategy that survives only under conditions of repeated contact and observable behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 博弈论把这个词技术化：合作不是善意，而是在重复接触与可观察行为条件下才存活的策略。

intro.en: Cooperation comes from Late Latin cooperari, built on com- 'together' and operari 'to work', itself from opus 'work'. It reached English through French. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cooperation 来自晚期拉丁 cooperari，由 com-「一起」与 operari「做事」构成，而 operari 又源自 opus「工作」。它经法语进入英语。年代为约数。

items.en: Opus meant 'work, a piece of work'; its stem oper- supplies the verb operari 'to work, labour'.
items.cn: opus 意为「工作、一件作品」；其词干 oper- 构成动词 operari「做事、劳作」。

items.en: Cooperari combined com- 'together' with operari, meaning 'to work together, collaborate'. The prefix assimilated to co- before the vowel.
items.cn: cooperari 把 com-「一起」与 operari 组合，意为「共同做事、协作」；前缀在元音前同化为 co-。

items.en: French coopération carried the noun into English in the sixteenth or seventeenth century; cooperate followed in the same period.
items.cn: 法语 coopération 在 16 或 17 世纪把名词带入英语；动词 cooperate 也在同一时期进入。

items.en: The economic and international senses date mainly from the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, when firms, unions and states began to sign standing agreements.
items.cn: 经济与国际义主要形成于 19 与 20 世纪，当时公司、工会与国家开始签订长期协议。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the earliest English citation of cooperation is not firmly fixed, and dictionaries differ on whether the noun came straight from Latin or through French.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：cooperation 在英语中的最早书证没有确切年代；词典对名词是直接来自拉丁还是经法语而来也有分歧。

note.en: Group one holds forms from the same co- plus oper- family; group two holds words that also describe joint work but differ in emphasis.
note.cn: 第一组是同一 co- 加 oper- 词族的词；第二组同样描述共同工作，但侧重不同。

entries.definition: Willing to help, or a member-owned business; it describes a quality or an entity, not the activity itself.
entries.definitionCN: 愿意配合的，或成员共有的企业；描述性质或实体，而非活动本身。

entries.definition: To run or work a machine or system; without co- there is no second agent.
entries.definitionCN: 操作机器或运行系统；没有 co- 就没有第二个行动者。

entries.definition: The act of running something, or a surgical procedure; it does not require a partner.
entries.definitionCN: 运行某物，或外科手术；不需要伙伴。

entries.definition: A joint owner; the prefix is the same, but the root is own, not work.
entries.definitionCN: 共同所有人；前缀相同，但词根是 own（拥有），而非 work（工作）。

entries.definition: Working jointly, especially on a creative or intellectual project; it stresses the shared product more than the shared labour.
entries.definitionCN: 共同工作，尤指创意或学术项目；更强调共同成果而非共同劳动。

entries.definition: Organizing separate efforts so that they fit together; cooperation supplies the will, coordination the schedule.
entries.definitionCN: 把各自的努力组织到合适的位置；cooperation 提供意愿，coordination 提供时序。

entries.definition: The combined effort of a team; it is warmer and less formal than cooperation.
entries.definitionCN: 团队的合力；比 cooperation 更口语、更亲切。

entries.definition: A biological relationship in which both species benefit; the technical name for cooperation across species.
entries.definitionCN: 两个物种都获益的生物学关系；是跨物种合作的技术名称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: co- 'together' + operari 'work' = work together; the same root appears in operate and opera.
normal.cn: co-「一起」+ operari「做事」= 共同做事；同一词根也出现在 operate 与 opera 中。

normal.en: The family runs cooperate, cooperative, cooperation, cooperator and cooperatively.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 cooperate、cooperative、cooperation、cooperator 与 cooperatively。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: close cooperation, international cooperation, in cooperation with, full cooperation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：紧密合作、国际合作、与……合作、全力配合。

normal.en: The preposition matters: in cooperation with means two parties, while with the cooperation of means one party assisting another.
normal.cn: 介词很关键：说「与……合作」时指双方，说「在某方的配合下」时指一方协助另一方。

normal.en: Biology has its own word, mutualism, for cooperation between species.
normal.cn: 生物学有专门术语「互利共生」指物种之间的合作。

abstract.en: Picture two people carrying one heavy table, each holding a different end.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人抬一张重桌，各自抓住不同的一端。

abstract.en: Picture a rowing crew whose oars enter the water on the same beat.
abstract.cn: 想象赛艇队员的桨在同一拍入水。

abstract.en: Picture a machine whose parts each do one motion so that the whole moves.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器，每个部件各做一个动作，整体才动起来。

examples.en: The project succeeded through close cooperation between the two labs.
examples.cn: 这个项目靠两个实验室的紧密合作而成功。

examples.en: Police thanked the public for its cooperation during the search.
examples.cn: 警方感谢公众在搜寻期间的配合。

examples.en: Clean-energy cooperation between the two countries began in the 1990s.
examples.cn: 两国的清洁能源合作始于 20 世纪 90 年代。

dict_mnemonic.text: co（一起）+ operation（操作）——几个人一起操作同一件事 → 合作

root: 拉丁晚期 cooperari「共同做事」= com-（一起）+ operari「工作」（源自 opus「工作」）。英语经法语借入。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep the same division of labour but change the setting: a task, a request, a species pair, two institutions, two states, a body's parts, an authority, a game.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项保持同一种分工，只更换场景：一项任务、一次请求、一对物种、两个机构、两个国家、身体各部、一个执法方、一场博弈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one load, two pairs of hands, each taking a different end.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件重物，两双手，各自抬住不同的一端。

branches.en: THE CORE: a shared aim is what turns separate efforts into one act.
branches.cn: 核心：共同目标把分散的努力变成同一个动作。

branches.en: THE ATTITUDE: willingness is the door through which help enters.
branches.cn: 态度：意愿是帮助得以进入的那道门。

branches.en: ACROSS SPECIES: biology measures the shared benefit in survival.
branches.cn: 跨物种：生物学用存活来衡量共同收益。

branches.en: ACROSS BORDERS: institutions and states cooperate without merging.
branches.cn: 跨越边界：机构与国家合作而不合并。

branches.en: OTHER SHAPES: parts, compliance and strategy all keep the same division of labour.
branches.cn: 其他形态：部件、顺从与策略都保持同一种分工。

intro.en: Cooperation is a prefix-root noun: co- 'together' plus operari 'to work' plus -ation. The same root family runs through operate, operation and opera.
intro.cn: cooperation 是前缀加词根的名词：co-「一起」加 operari「做事」，再加 -ation。同一词根族贯穿 operate、operation 与 opera。

latinIntro.en: Latin opus 'work' gives operari and, with com-, cooperari; English takes cooperate, cooperation, cooperative and cooperator from this line.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 opus「工作」生成 operari，并与 com- 合成 cooperari；英语由此得到 cooperate、cooperation、cooperative 与 cooperator。

items.example: Before a vowel the prefix shortens to co-.
items.exampleCN: 在元音前这个前缀缩为 co-。

items.example: Opus is the noun behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: opus 是整个词族背后的名词。

items.example: Operari supplies the verbal idea of labour.
items.exampleCN: operari 提供「劳作」的动词含义。

items.example: The Late Latin verb named joint labour.
items.exampleCN: 这个晚期拉丁动词命名共同劳动。
cooperari 加 -ation 命名这项活动。
合作需要一个共同目标。

definition_zh: 合作的；愿意配合的；合作社（成员共有、共同经营的组织或场所）
definition_en: willing to work with others, involving joint effort, or a business owned and run by its members
core_image: 几位成员围坐一圈，各出一份力，也各分一份收益
scene: 小区门口，住户们轮流值守新开的共享菜园，收成按工时分配。Neighbours take turns tending the shared garden and divide the harvest by hours worked, an arrangement they describe as cooperative.
sceneCN: 这里 cooperative 指「成员共同出力、共同分享的」（第 2 个义项：合作式的安排）；句意为住户轮流照看共享菜园、按工时分配收成，他们把这种安排称作合作式的。图中可辨识物件：菜园、值班表、收成筐、按工时记录的本子。

pos.zh: 合作的；愿意配合的；合作性质的
合作社；合作商店；合作公寓

senses.title: Willing to help or agree
senses.definition: willing to do what is asked and to work with others without resistance
senses.definitionCN: 愿意按要求做事、与他人配合而不抵触
senses.example: The witness was cooperative and answered every question.
senses.exampleCN: 证人很配合，回答了每一个问题。
senses.why: the adjective turns joint work into a personal disposition: a cooperative person is one whose work can be joined to yours.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把共同工作变成个人性情：配合的人，其劳动能与你的劳动接上。

senses.title: Done by sharing the work
senses.definition: describing an activity or arrangement in which several people share the effort
senses.definitionCN: 描述由若干人分担努力的活动或安排
senses.example: Neighbours tend the shared garden in a cooperative arrangement.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们以合作的方式共同照看菜园。
senses.why: here the word modifies the arrangement rather than the person; the sharing is built into the structure, not into anyone's mood.
senses.whyCN: 这里修饰的是安排而非人；共享被写进结构里，而不取决于谁的心情。

senses.title: A member-owned business
senses.definition: a business owned and run by its members, who share the profits
senses.definitionCN: 由成员共有共营并分享利润的企业
senses.example: The farmers sell milk through a local cooperative.
senses.exampleCN: 农民通过当地合作社出售牛奶。
senses.why: the nineteenth-century cooperative movement turned the adjective into a noun: an enterprise whose ownership is itself the joint work.
senses.whyCN: 19 世纪的合作社运动把这个形容词变成名词：一种所有权本身就是共同劳动的企业。

senses.title: A jointly owned apartment building
senses.definition: a building owned jointly by its residents, who share costs and decisions
senses.definitionCN: 由住户共同拥有、共同承担费用与决策的住宅
senses.example: They bought a two-bedroom cooperative in the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在老城买了一套两居室的合作公寓。
senses.why: housing repeats the same structure as a shop: many owners, one property, shared rules. In speech it shortens to co-op.
senses.whyCN: 住房重复了商店的同一种结构：多个业主、一处房产、共享规则；口语中缩为「合作公寓」的简称。

senses.title: Cooperative breeding in animals
senses.definition: a system in which individuals other than the parents help raise the young
senses.definitionCN: 由父母以外的个体帮助抚养幼崽的体系
senses.example: In cooperative breeding, older offspring feed their younger siblings.
senses.exampleCN: 在合作育幼中，较大的后代喂养更小的弟妹。
senses.why: biology applies the adjective to a reproductive system, where help is measurable as extra surviving young.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把这个形容词用于繁殖体系，其中的帮助可用多存活的幼崽来衡量。

senses.title: Cooperative learning in class
senses.definition: an instructional method in which students work in small groups on a shared task
senses.definitionCN: 学生在小组中共同完成一项任务的教学方法
senses.example: The teacher sets a cooperative learning task for mixed pairs.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给混合搭配的小组布置合作学习任务。
senses.why: education borrowed the word for structured sharing: the group is arranged so that each member must contribute a part.
senses.whyCN: 教育学借用这个词来指有结构的共享：小组被安排成每个成员都必须贡献一部分。

senses.title: A cooperative patient or subject
senses.titleCN: 配合治疗的病人或受试者
senses.definition: a person who follows instructions during treatment or an experiment
senses.definitionCN: 在治疗或实验中遵从指示的人
senses.example: The nurse noted that the patient was calm and cooperative.
senses.exampleCN: 护士记录病人平静且配合。
senses.why: clinical use narrows the word to compliance: the patient's work is to accept the procedure without obstructing it.
senses.whyCN: 临床用法把词义收窄为顺从：病人的「工作」就是不阻碍地接受程序。

senses.title: The shortened form co-op
senses.titleCN: 口语缩略形式：合作社的简称
senses.definition: the informal short form for a cooperative shop, farm or apartment
senses.definitionCN: 合作社商店、合作农场或合作公寓的口语简称
senses.example: She picks up vegetables at the co-op every Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周五在合作社买蔬菜。
senses.why: frequent use wears the long word down; co-op keeps the first and last pieces and drops the middle.
senses.whyCN: 高频使用让长词变短；缩略形式保留头尾、丢掉中间。

intro.en: Cooperative is built from cooperari 'to work together' plus the adjective suffix -ive. The noun sense grew out of nineteenth-century cooperative societies. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cooperative 由 cooperari「共同做事」加形容词后缀 -ive 构成。名词义从 19 世纪的合作社团发展而来。年代为约数。

items.en: Cooperari 'to work together' joins com- 'together' to operari 'to work', from opus 'work'.
items.cn: cooperari「共同做事」把 com-「一起」与 operari「做事」结合，后者源自 opus「工作」。

items.en: Late Latin cooperativus 'tending to work together' added -ivus to the participial stem; English took the adjective in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 cooperativus 意为「倾向于共同做事的」，在分词词干后加 -ivus；英语在 17 世纪借入该形容词。

items.en: From the 1820s onward cooperative societies spread in Britain and Europe, and the adjective became a noun for the shop or farm itself.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪 20 年代起，合作社团在英国与欧洲传播，这个形容词逐渐变成指商店或农场本身的名词。

items.en: Cooperative learning, cooperative breeding and cooperative housing are all twentieth-century extensions of the same idea of shared effort.
items.cn: 合作学习、合作育幼与合作住房都是 20 世纪对「共同出力」这一相同观念的延伸。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the exact date of the first noun use in English is not agreed, and the older cooperative society is often dated only by its first recorded rulebook.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：英语中名词义的最早年代没有定论；较早的「合作会社」这一说法常只能按最早留存的章程年代推定。

note.en: Group one holds words that look close to cooperative; group two holds near-synonyms with different grammar or emphasis.
note.cn: 第一组是外形接近 cooperative 的词；第二组是语法或侧重不同的近义词。

entries.definition: The activity of working together; cooperative is the adjective or the organization, not the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 共同做事的活动；cooperative 是形容词或组织，不是活动本身。

entries.definition: To run a machine or carry out a procedure; there is no second agent in the word.
entries.definitionCN: 操作机器或施行程序；词中没有第二个行动者。

entries.definition: Functioning or effective, as in the operative clause; it comes from the same root but means 'working', not 'working together'.
entries.definitionCN: 运作的、有效的，如生效条款；同词根，但意为「在运作」，不是「一起运作」。

entries.definition: The spoken short form of cooperative; it is the same entity with its middle syllables cut away.
entries.definitionCN: cooperative 的口语缩略；指同一实体，只是中间音节被省掉。

entries.definition: Describing work shared on a project, often intellectual; it stresses the shared product rather than a willingness to obey.
entries.definitionCN: 描述项目上的共同工作，常指智力项目；强调共同成果，而非服从意愿。

entries.definition: Willing to be useful; it is warmer and more general than cooperative and carries no organizational sense.
entries.definitionCN: 愿意提供帮助；比 cooperative 更亲切、更一般，也没有组织含义。

entries.definition: Shared by a whole group; it describes ownership or identity, while cooperative also implies joint work.
entries.definitionCN: 由整个群体共有；描述所有权或身份，而 cooperative 还隐含共同劳动。

entries.definition: Felt or done by both sides toward each other; mutual describes the direction of a relation, not its organization.
entries.definitionCN: 双方彼此做出的；描述关系的方向，而非组织形式。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: cooperat- 'work together' + -ive 'tending to': a person or arrangement that tends to share the work.
normal.cn: cooperat-「共同做事」+ -ive「倾向于」：倾向于分担工作的人或安排。

normal.en: The family runs cooperate, cooperation, cooperative, cooperatively and co-op.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 cooperate、cooperation、cooperative、cooperatively 与 co-op。

normal.en: Fixed phrases cover the senses: cooperative witness, cooperative society, cooperative learning, cooperative breeding.
normal.cn: 固定搭配覆盖各义项：配合的证人、合作社团、合作学习、合作育幼。

normal.en: As a noun, cooperative usually means a business; as an adjective, it usually means willing.
normal.cn: 作名词时通常指合作社；作形容词时通常指愿意配合。

normal.en: The short form co-op is informal and appears mainly in speech and shop signs.
normal.cn: 缩略形式 co-op 偏口语，主要出现在口语与店招中。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of members each putting one coin into the same box and each taking one share out.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈成员各往同一个箱子里放一枚硬币，又各取一份出来。

abstract.en: Picture a class where every student holds one piece of the only map.
abstract.cn: 想象一个班级，每个学生只拿到唯一那张地图的一块。

abstract.en: Picture a hive where no single bee could build the comb alone.
abstract.cn: 想象一个蜂巢，没有哪只蜜蜂能独自造出整片巢脾。

examples.en: The staff were cooperative even though the request came at midnight.
examples.cn: 尽管请求是在午夜提出的，工作人员仍然很配合。

examples.en: The cooperative sells coffee grown by its own members.
examples.cn: 这家合作社出售成员自己种植的咖啡。

examples.en: Cooperative breeding means that helpers raise chicks that are not their own.
examples.cn: 合作育幼意味着帮手抚养并非自己的雏鸟。

dict_mnemonic.text: cooperate（合作）+ ive（……的）——愿意一起做事的；由成员共有的组织 → 合作的；合作社

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split into two branches: an attitude or arrangement that shares work, and the organizations or methods built on that sharing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分成两支：一是分担工作的态度或安排，二是建立在这种分担之上的组织或方法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: members around one table, each contributing a part and receiving a share.
core.cn: 核心意象：成员围着一张桌子，各贡献一部分，也各分得一份。

branches.en: THE PERSON: willingness measured as compliance in a clinic or a witness box.
branches.cn: 人：在诊室或证人席上以顺从程度衡量的意愿。

branches.en: THE ARRANGEMENT: a structure in which each member must contribute a part.
branches.cn: 安排：一种要求每个成员贡献一部分的结构。

branches.en: THE PROPERTY: shop and apartment turn shared ownership into a noun.
branches.cn: 财产：商店与公寓把共同所有权变成名词。

branches.en: THE BIOLOGY: help measured in extra surviving young.
branches.cn: 生物学：以多存活的幼崽衡量的帮助。

branches.en: THE CLIPPING: use wears the long word down to co-op.
branches.cn: 缩略：高频使用把长词磨成短形式。

intro.en: Cooperative is cooperari plus the adjective suffix -ive; the noun sense adds no new morpheme, only a new grammatical role.
intro.cn: cooperative 是 cooperari 加形容词后缀 -ive；名词义没有新增语素，只是换了语法角色。

latinIntro.en: Latin opus 'work' gives operari, then cooperari and cooperativus; English forms cooperate, cooperation, cooperative, cooperator and the clipping co-op.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 opus「工作」生成 operari，再生成 cooperari 与 cooperativus；英语构成 cooperate、cooperation、cooperative、cooperator 与缩略 co-op。

items.exampleCN: co- 标记词中的第二个行动者。

items.example: Opus is the source of the oper- stem.
items.exampleCN: opus 是 oper- 词干的来源。
operari 提供「做事」这一动词义。

items.example: The partners cooperated on the survey.
items.exampleCN: 伙伴们共同完成这项调查。

items.meaning: tending to, having the quality of

items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「合作」变成一种倾向。

items.meaningCN: 倾向于合作的；共同所有的企业

items.exampleCN: 合作社商店由成员共有。
合作使这次收成成为可能。

items.meaningCN: 合作社商店或合作公寓

items.example: Two people are needed to operate the lift.
items.exampleCN: 操作这部升降机需要两个人。

definition_zh: 协调；使配合；坐标；同等的
definition_en: to make different parts work well together, a position on a map, or equal in rank
core_image: 几路人马在同一张时间表上对齐，指针同时指向一处
scene: 几支队伍先后赶来，负责人先把时间和路线排好。She coordinated the rescue from a small tent.
sceneCN: 这里 coordinate 指「协调」（第 1 个义项：让不同部分配合起来）；句意是她在一个小帐篷里协调这次救援。

senses.title: To bring parts into step
senses.definition: to arrange different people or parts so that they work well together
senses.definitionCN: 安排不同的人或部分，使其配合良好
senses.example: She coordinated the work of four teams.
senses.exampleCN: 她协调了四个团队的工作。
senses.why: Separate clocks tell separate times until one hand sets them all.
senses.whyCN: 各自走时的钟各说各话，直到有一只手把它们调齐。

senses.title: A position on a grid
senses.definition: one of the numbers that fix a point on a map or graph
senses.definitionCN: 在地图或图表上确定一个点的数值之一
senses.example: The ship sent its coordinates by radio.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船用无线电发出了坐标。
senses.why: Two numbers can pin down one exact spot in a wide world.
senses.whyCN: 两个数字就能在广阔世界里钉住一个确切的点。

senses.title: Equal in rank
senses.definition: having the same level or importance as another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物处于相同层级或同等重要
senses.example: The two clauses are coordinate in grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个分句在语法上是并列的。
senses.why: Things set side by side stand on one level.
senses.whyCN: 并排放置的东西，站在同一个高度上。

intro.en: Coordinate comes from Latin co-, together, and ordinare, to arrange, from ordo, order or row.
intro.cn: coordinate 来自拉丁语 co-（一起）与 ordinare（排列），词根 ordo 意为次序、行列。

items.en: Ordo meant a row, a rank or a settled order.
items.cn: ordo 意为行列、等级或既定次序。

items.en: Ordinare meant to set things in rows and put them in order.
items.cn: ordinare 意为把事物排成行、理出次序。

items.en: Coordinare meant to arrange several things together.
items.cn: coordinare 意为把几样事物一同排列。

items.en: English coordinate first described things of equal rank.
items.cn: 英语 coordinate 最初形容等级相同的事物。

items.en: Mathematics gave the noun the sense of a fixed position.
items.cn: 数学赋予这个名词固定位置的含义。

items.en: The verb now mostly means to bring work into step.
items.cn: 今天动词主要表示把工作安排得彼此合拍。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ordering base ordin-, and the meaning group names other verbs of making things fit.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的排列词基 ordin-，近义组列出其他使事物相合的说法。

entries.definition: the act of making parts work together
entries.definitionCN: 让各部分配合起来的做法

entries.definition: a person who brings work together
lower in rank than another
to arrange things into a working whole
entries.definitionCN: 把事物安排成一个运作的整体

entries.definition: to make things happen at the same time
to bring things into a straight line or agreement
entries.definitionCN: 使事物成一直线或达成一致

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with several clocks set to one time, then move to numbers fixing a spot and to things standing level.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从几只被调成同一时间的钟开始，再到确定位置的数字，最后到站在同一高度的事物。

normal.en: Co- is together and ordinate is arranged in order, so coordinate is to put things in one order.
normal.cn: co- 是一起，ordinate 是排成次序，coordinate 就是把事物排进同一个次序。

normal.en: Think of a conductor who never plays a note but keeps everyone together.
normal.cn: 想象一位指挥家，自己不奏一个音，却让所有人合在一起。

normal.en: Two numbers on a map are also a kind of order.
normal.cn: 地图上的两个数字，也是一种次序。

normal.en: The same word means to arrange and to stand at the same level.
normal.cn: 同一个词既表示安排，也表示处在同一层级。

normal.en: Remember co- means together in all three senses.
normal.cn: 记住三个义项里都藏着 co- 的一起。

abstract.en: Picture four clocks hung in a row, all showing one time.
abstract.cn: 想象四只钟挂成一排，都指向同一个时间。

abstract.en: Picture a cross on a map with two numbers beside it.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上一个十字，旁边写着两个数字。

abstract.en: Picture two blocks placed side by side at one height.
abstract.cn: 想象两块积木并排放在同一高度。

examples.en: She coordinated the whole event by phone.
examples.cn: 她通过电话协调了整个活动。

examples.en: Write down the coordinates before you move.
examples.cn: 行动之前先把坐标记下来。

examples.en: The two departments work as coordinate units.
examples.cn: 这两个部门作为同级单位合作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coordinate 记成 co（一起）加 ordin（次序）加 ate：把事情排进同一个次序，就是协调。

root: 源自拉丁语 coordinare（一同排列），由 co-（一起）与 ordinare（排列）构成，词根 ordo 意为次序，后兼指坐标与同级。

sensesIntro.en: From clocks set to one time, to numbers fixing a spot, and at last to things standing on one level.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被调成同一时间的钟，到确定一个点的数字，最后到站在同一层级的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several hands setting clocks to one time.
core.cn: 核心意象：几只手把钟调到同一个时间。

branches.en: Separate efforts are brought into one rhythm.
branches.cn: 分散的努力被带进同一个节奏。

branches.en: Numbers on a grid name one exact place.
branches.cn: 网格上的数字命名一个确切的位置。

branches.en: Two items stand side by side without one bowing.
branches.cn: 两样东西并排而立，谁也不必低头。

branches.en: Both depend on things being set in relation to each other.
branches.cn: 两者都依赖事物之间的相互关系。

branches.en: A coordinate tells where, and to coordinate tells when and how.
branches.cn: 坐标说明在哪里，协调说明何时与如何。

intro.en: Coordinate is built on Latin co-, together, plus ordinare, to set in order.

intro.en: Coordination comes from Latin coordinatio, from coordinare, to arrange together, built from co-, together, and ordo, order.
intro.cn: coordination 来自拉丁语 coordinatio，源于 coordinare（一同排列），由 co-（一起）与 ordo（次序）构成。

items.en: Ordo meant a row, a rank or a fixed arrangement.
items.cn: ordo 意为行列、等级或固定的排列。

items.en: Coordinare meant to set several things into one arrangement.
items.cn: coordinare 意为把几样事物排进同一个安排。

items.en: Coordinatio named the state of being arranged together.
items.cn: coordinatio 指被一同排列的状态。

items.en: English coordination first described equal rank in logic.
items.cn: 英语 coordination 最初描述逻辑中的同级关系。

items.en: It now covers teamwork, muscles and grammar alike.
items.cn: 今天它同时涵盖团队协作、肌肉动作与语法关系。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ordering base ordin-, and the meaning group names other forms of joint effort.

items.en: Colaphus kept the sense of a blow or a buffet.

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a maker fencing a work, then move to the act of registering and to a fence already standing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从创作者为作品围起篱笆开始，再到登记这道篱笆，最后到已经立好的篱笆。

normal.en: Copyright is simply copy plus right: the right over copies.
normal.cn: copyright 就是 copy 加 right：对副本的权利。

normal.en: The symbol on a book is a small fence around the words.
normal.cn: 书上的那个符号，是围住文字的一道小篱笆。

normal.en: A song can be copied in a second, so the right must be written down.
normal.cn: 一首歌一秒就能被复制，所以这项权利必须写下来。

normal.en: Compare it with patent: one protects a work, the other an invention.
normal.cn: 和 patent 比一比：一个保护作品，一个保护发明。

normal.en: The verb is young, and it means to put that fence in place.
normal.cn: 动词用法出现较晚，意思是把这道篱笆立起来。

abstract.en: Picture a small fence around a single printed page.
abstract.cn: 想象一道小篱笆围着一页印好的纸。

abstract.en: Picture a name written at the foot of a song.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌的末尾写着一个名字。

abstract.en: Picture a key that locks a box of copies.
abstract.cn: 想象一把钥匙锁住一箱副本。

examples.en: The publisher owns the copyright to the novel.
examples.cn: 出版社拥有这部小说的版权。

examples.en: They copyrighted the software in three countries.
examples.cn: 他们在三个国家为这款软件取得了版权。

examples.en: You may not post copyright material without permission.
examples.cn: 未经许可，你不得发布受版权保护的材料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 copyright 记成 copy（复制）加 right（权利）：决定谁能复制的权利，就是版权。

root: 由 copy（源自拉丁语 copia，抄本）与 right（古英语 riht，正当权利）合成，十八世纪印刷法促成其法律含义，现指著作权。

sensesIntro.en: From a maker fencing a work, to the act of raising the fence, and at last to the fence standing around the work.
sensesIntro.cn: 从创作者为作品围起篱笆，到立起篱笆的动作，最后到已经围在作品周围的篱笆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small fence around a printed page.
core.cn: 核心意象：围着印好纸页的一道小篱笆。

branches.en: A creator holds a right over every copy of the work.
branches.cn: 创作者对作品的每一份副本都握有权利。

branches.en: Registering turns an idea of ownership into a fact on paper.
branches.cn: 登记把归属的念头变成纸上的事实。

branches.en: A work already fenced is marked as protected.
branches.cn: 已经围上篱笆的作品被标明受到保护。

branches.en: The right and the act of claiming it are two stages.
branches.cn: 权利本身与主张权利的动作是两个阶段。

branches.en: Once claimed, the work stays marked as protected.
branches.cn: 一旦主张，作品就持续被标为受保护。

intro.en: Copyright is a compound of copy and right, and it takes -ed and -able in English.
intro.cn: copyright 由 copy 与 right 复合而成，在英语里可加 -ed 与 -able。

latinIntro.en: The copy half goes back to Latin copia, plenty, which also gives copious.
latinIntro.cn: copy 这一半可追溯到拉丁语 copia（丰富），它也带来了 copious。

items.meaning: the right over copies of a work
items.meaningCN: 对作品副本所享的权利

items.meaning: able to be protected by copyright

items.exampleCN: 一名抄写员做了这份抄本。

items.example: She has a right to reply.
